system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:58 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 sent 51,000,389 bytes to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 over a connection lasting about nine seconds; the proxy returned 9,017 bytes. This is consistent with the alert's large outbound transfer.
The available record for that large flow identifies the proxy as the destination, but does not identify the ultimate remote destination, request method, or transferred content.

At 14:12–14:13 UTC, proxy records show ivy.chen's Chrome browser accessing AWS pages and static AWS resources. These later GET requests do not establish that the earlier large transfer went to AWS or was related to it.

The available evidence does not link the large flow to a specific endpoint process: the flow record gives connection details but no process identity, while the supplied Chrome process/network records concern later connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence has a Zeek connection record for the large flow but no corresponding proxy request or upstream-destination details for that time (T039-00140).
The supplied endpoint records do not identify which process produced the 13:45:58 flow; the process-linked Chrome network records shown are from 14:12 onward (T039-00140, T039-00268, T039-00270).
The later AWS proxy records show browser GET requests, not the contents or destination of the earlier large transfer (T039-00266, T039-00267, T039-00272, T039-00286).
claims_not_established: The ultimate external destination of the large transfer.
What data was transferred, whether it contained sensitive information, or whether it was an upload initiated by a user or software.
Whether the transfer was authorized or malicious, and which user or process initiated it.
That the later AWS browsing was related to the large transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy logs for the 13:45:58 connection, including the requested host or URL, method, authenticated user, upstream destination, and any available request or response metadata.
Endpoint EDR or process-level network telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:45:50–13:46:10 UTC, including process tree, command line, and relevant file-access events.
If the proxy evidence identifies an AWS destination or account, corresponding AWS sign-in, CloudTrail, and object-upload records for that time.
User or application context explaining the transfer and whether it was expected.
